content.short: Spectrum provides decentralised RPC infrastructure with distributed endpoints for Web3 apps.
content.description: Spectrum runs RPC infrastructure on a decentralised model, spreading endpoints across operators rather than concentrating them in one provider's data centres. Monad's documentation lists it among supported RPC providers. Endpoint concentration is a real liveness risk for applications, since an outage at a single large provider tends to take a visible share of the ecosystem offline at the same moment.
